entities.name: P48181 UNC-29
observations: Exact sequence match to the 493-residue query; reviewed Caenorhabditis elegans beta-type nicotinic acetylcholine receptor subunit.
Contains Neur_chan_LBD (PF02931) at positions 30–230 and Neur_chan_memb (PF02932) at positions 237–462.
Annotated as a multi-pass postsynaptic plasma-membrane protein and non-alpha subunit of a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor.
Curated receptor complex contains two non-alpha subunits, UNC-29 and LEV-1, plus three alpha subunits UNC-38, UNC-63, and LEV-8.
Associated processes include cholinergic neuromuscular synaptic transmission, cation/calcium ion transport, membrane-potential regulation, and locomotion.

entities.name: C. elegans nAChR complex
observations: Curated UNC-29 annotation describes a pentameric acetylcholine-gated cation channel containing UNC-29, LEV-1, UNC-38, UNC-63, and LEV-8.

entities.name: Cholinergic neuromuscular transmission
observations: UNC-29-containing nicotinic acetylcholine receptors contribute to acetylcholine-gated cation flux at postsynaptic synapses and thereby support neuromuscular transmission and locomotion in C. elegans.
